author: minimax-m2.5
brief: A near-miss twin on an existing repository (the booking API in fixture/). The request shares words with a rate-limiting task (API keys, plans, requests, headers) but asks for one small, well specified addition with no limiting: a GET /api/v1/bookings/export route that returns every booking as CSV (a fixed header line and column order you state in the request, RFC 4180 quoting for commas, quotes and line breaks, Content-Type text/csv), with an optional `from` and `to` date filter that rejects a malformed date with a 400 JSON error. Hidden tests call the route through the app's own createApp.
